findings.problem: `success_statuses: set[int] | None = None` is coalesced with `success_statuses or {200, 201}`, which uses truthiness rather than an explicit `is None` check. findings.title: or-fallback treats empty success_statuses set same as None
findings.why_it_matters: This is the classic Python `or`-as-default pitfall for Optional parameters: it works for every call site in this diff (all pass a non-empty literal set) but silently breaks for a legitimate future input, producing an incorrect success/failure classification for an HTTP response rather than an obvious crash.
